subject: Post-call: Alpine Retail priorities & MAP proposal
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@alpineretail.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 14:08:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Alpine Retail priorities & MAP proposal

Thanks again for your time today, Samir — appreciate the candid discussion. Quick recap from our side and a proposed set of next steps so we stay aligned. Attached: Alpine-MAP-v1.pdf (short MAP draft).

Call highlights / confirmed pain:
- P99 latency spikes on recommendation API during peak that impact conversion windows.
- Token costs are unpredictable across current bursts; engineering wants predictable unit economics.
- Multi-region reads required (US + EU) with consistent performance.
- Need to preserve KV cache across sessions for personalization; current stack struggles with warm starts.

Goals you articulated:
- P99 latency <= 250ms for 99% of requests at expected load.
- Reduce per-token operational cost by ~30–40% vs current baseline.
- Run a focused pilot for recommendations (user-sim corpus of ~500k tokens/day) and decide by end of Q3.

Proposed immediate next steps (high level):
1) Technical demo for Marcus + SRE (live traffic profile) — target week of Jul 25.
2) Shared security questionnaire + SOC2 summary (we'll provide) — complete by Aug 2.
3) 4-week pilot (POC) with dedicated capacity or hosted variant — target Aug 15–Sep 12.
4) Procurement & legal review — aim for sign-off by Sep 20, production goal Oct 10.

Ask from you: please confirm the decision owners we talked about (Elena for product strategy, Marcus for SRE, procurement@alpineretail.com). If that looks right, I'll circulate a short MAP with owners and dates.

Attachments: Alpine-MAP-v1.pdf (draft)

Best,
Laura Bennett
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@alpineretail.com>

Subject: Re: Post-call: Alpine Retail priorities & MAP proposal

Laura — thanks for the concise recap, this is helpful. Confirming stakeholders: Elena Torres (VP Product) is the exec sponsor; Marcus Lin (Head of SRE) will own the technical evaluation; procurement will handle contracting.

A few questions / asks from our side:
- Can you send SOC2 summary and your standard SLA + SSO options (SAML)? Marcus will want details.
- We ran a quick sizing exercise — would like a ballpark for hosted vs dedicated TCO for a pilot (~1M tokens/month baseline with peaks up to 5M). A range is fine.
- I attached our vendor questionnaire (vendor-questionnaire.docx) — if you can populate or point to docs that answer the security/residency Qs, that'd speed things up.

We'd also like Aditya on the demo with Marcus. Proposed timeline looks reasonable; we want the MAP with specific dates and owners before the demo so procurement can pre-check major blockers.

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Director, Engineering — Recommendations
Samir.Patel@alpineretail.com | +1 (212) 555-0190

Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2028 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Alpine Retail priorities & MAP proposal — updated MAP and dates

Samir — appreciate the fast responses. Attached is Alpine-MAP-v2.pdf with owners and proposed dates (lower friction version for procurement). Key points and clarified timeline below.

Mutual Action Plan (summary):
- Demo (Marcus + SRE + Aditya joining): Jul 25, 2028 — owner: Aditya Rao (SE) — success metric: baseline P50/P95/P99 under synthetic load.
- Security questionnaire responses + SOC2 summary delivered: Aug 2, 2028 — owner: Laura Bennett — deliverables: SOC2 attestation summary, data residency statement, encryption at rest/in transit notes.
- Pilot (4-week POC) — Aug 15 to Sep 12, 2028 — owner: Alpine technical team + Redwood SE — scope: recommendations model, KV cache config, multi-region routing enabled.
- Procurement & legal sign-off: target Sep 20, 2028 — owner: procurement@alpineretail.com / Redwood legal.
- Production readiness & cutover: Oct 10, 2028 — owner: Alpine engineering + Redwood deploy team.

Pricing (ballpark for planning):
- Hosted (managed API): ~ $1,200–$2,000 per 1M tokens / month (depends on model family & burst allowances).
- Dedicated (reserved capacity for pilot): pricing typically starts with a monthly commit; for a small pilot the range is ~$8k–$20k/month depending on GPU class and throughput guarantees.

Docs and links:
- Alpine-MAP-v2.pdf (attached) — high-level gantt + owner matrix.
- HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/record/RW-ALP-2028
- DocuSign (MOU, optional milestone-level): https://docusign.com/initial-mou/alpine-rw-2028

Next asks from our side before the demo:
1) Can procurement confirm any mandatory vendor terms or must-have clauses (if you can share the procurement playbook or key redlines, we can pre-clear with our legal team).
2) Marcus — can you share a 24h trace snippet or representative traffic profile (no PII) so Aditya can craft a realistic load for the demo? If not, give QPS and typical sequence length distribution.

I'll send the MAP PDF now. If the dates above look off, tell me the preferred windows and I'll update.

Thanks — talk soon,
Laura Bennett
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: Alpine-MAP-v2.pdf
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Alpine Retail priorities & MAP proposal — technical follow-up (internal)

Internal note — quick technical checklist before the demo:
- Confirm SAML metadata (IdP) and whether Alpine needs SSO for the Admin Console.
- Data residency: they asked for EU support; we can provide EU-region routing but need to confirm data egress policy for logs.
- Sequence lengths: ask Marcus for 99th percentile token length; if >2k we need to test longer-context model variants.
- Throughput target: they suggested bursts up to 150 QPS for recommendations — we should simulate that with cold KV cache to see warm-up behavior.
- Pilot infra: recommend starting hosted with reserved burst capacity for the POC to reduce ops overhead; Profiler will collect latency histograms. If procurement insists on dedicated, I can size a 1x A100 equivalent for the pilot.

I'll draft the demo plan and synthetic load harness today and share before Jul 25.

- Aditya
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
